 DISMISSING THE APPEAL AND FILED AGAINST THE  JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 16.10.2012 PASSED IN  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:31823  MSA No. 99 of 2022 LAC.NO.263/2006 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE,
GUBBI, PARTLY ALLOWING THE REFERENCE PETITION FILED UNDER SECTION 23 OF THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL JUDGMENT Heard Sri.V.B.Siddaramaiah, learned counsel for the appellant, Sri.T.P.Malipatil, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 and Sri.K.S.Bheemaiah, learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2. Appellant is the land loser.

Land of the appellant to the extent of 20 guntas was acquired for the purpose of construction of Hemavathi Canal in C. Nandihalli Village, Cheluru Hobli, Gubbi Taluk,
Tumkuru District.
Acquisition and project being executed is not in dispute.
3. Land Acquisition Officer fixed the compensation at the rate of the land at Rs.345/- per gunta for the acquired land.
Being not satisfied by the compensation, claimant approached the reference Court wherein, land value was enhanced from Rs.345/- per gunta to Rs.1,000/- per gunta.
5. Being further not satisfied with said enhancement made by the reference Court, appellant filed an appeal before the First Appellate Court.
However, learned Judge in the First Appellate Court concurred with the enhancement made by the reference Court and dismissed the appeal.
6. Being aggrieved by the same, appellant is before this Court, in this appeal.

7. Sri.V.B.Siddaramaiah, learned counsel for the appellant reiterating the grounds urged in the appeal memorandum vehemently contended that this Court in respect of same notification and the land that has been acquired in the same village and same purpose, has NC: 2024:KHC:31823 Sri Bheemarao vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 7 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198629691/
2 redetermined the value of the land at Rs.6,000/- per gunta in MSA No.135/2021 dated 06.02.2023.
8.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He also submits that in respect of mango tree, this Court has fixed the value at Rs.1,01,055/- per tree where it is a fruit bearing tree.

9. He further contended that to the best of the knowledge of the appellant, the order passed by the coordinate Bench of this Court in MSA No.135/2021 is not challenged by the respondents and same is accepted and the compensation is paid to the claimants therein.
10.

Per contra, Sri.K.S.Bheemaiah, learned counsel for respondent No.2 supports the order of enhancement made by the reference Court to the extent of Rs.1,000/- per gunta towards the land value and so far as mango tree is concerned, he also disputes the age of the mango tree and sought for dismissal of the appeal.

Sri .T.P.Malipatil, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 supports the arguments put forth on behalf of respondent No.2.
12.
Having heard the parties in detail, this Court perused the material on record meticulously.

13. On such perusal of the material on record, it is crystal clear that in respect of similarly placed claimants, a coordinate Bench of this Court in MSA No.135/2021 has determined the land value in a sum of Rs.6,000/- per gunta.

Same is found from the order passed by the coordinate Bench of this Court in MSA No.135/2021, where the land of the claimants is acquired for the similar purpose under the same notification of C. Nandihalli Village.
14. Therefore, land value is to be redetermined in a sum of Rs.6,000/- per gunta in terms of the order passed by coordinate Bench of this Court in MSA No.135/2021.

Insofar as mango tree is concerned, only one mango tree was subject matter of the acquisition and there is no dispute that it is a fruit bearing tree in the absence of contra evidence placed on record by the respondent.
16. Accordingly, in respect of mango tree, claimant would be entitled to compensation in a sum of Rs.1,01,055/-.

17. Hence, following:
ORDER i. Appeal is allowed in part. ii.
The land value per gunta is redetermined in a sum of Rs.6,000/- and in respect of sole mango tree which was subject matter of the acquisition, the compensation amount is fixed at Rs.1,01,055/-.
